facts.to: 先撤owned标记，再Dispose；抛错可留下未回滚的旧映射
facts.behavior: 条件必须同时满足：同T已有previous、新service不是同引用、ownedServices.Remove(previous)返回true且previous实现IDisposable。该条件链先从ownedServices删除旧对象，再调用previous.Dispose；只有其正常返回才写services[typeof(T)]=新service及按owned标记登记新对象。旧Dispose抛异常时方法无catch/finally回滚：services仍映射旧previous，旧owned标记已移除，新service未写入，异常直接向调用者传播，也不调用RecordCleanupFailure。不能把注册失败描述为原状态完全不变。
facts.representation: services以Type为key保留对象引用；ownedServices是按ReferenceEquality比较的跨Type集合。新旧服务引用与该集合标记分开。
facts.cache: Service<T>()仍可能查回旧previous。后续root Release的服务候选来自ownedServices而非services全值，所以若旧对象没有另在states等候选中，它不再因这个服务映射获得自动Dispose重试。另有state/服务别名时不能据这一条断言永不再被Dispose。
facts.release: 这是服务替换入口的异常合同，区别于root Release逐资源catch/记失败后继续；服务注册并未采用同样的失败资源保留策略。

refs.excerpt: public void RegisterService<T>(T service,bool owned=true)where T:class{if(owner is not null){owner.RegisterService(service,owned);return;}ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(service);lock(gate){ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(closing,this);if(services.TryGetValue(typeof(T),out var previous)&&!ReferenceEquals(previous,service)&&ownedServices.Remove(previous)&&previous is IDisposable disposable)disposable.Dispose();services[typeof(T)]=service;if(owned)ownedServices.Add(service);}}
public T? Service<T>()where T:class{if(owner is not null)return owner.Service<T>();lock(gate)return services.TryGetValue(typeof(T),out var value)?(T)value:null;}

void Release(){object[] values;lock(gate){values=states.Values.Concat(ownedServices).Distinct(ReferenceEqualityComparer.Instance).ToArray();states.Clear();effectiveParameters.Clear();services.Clear();ownedServices.Clear();}foreach(var value in values)if(value is IDisposable disposable)try{disposable.Dispose();}catch(Exception error){RecordCleanupFailure("resource",value,error);}try{stopping.Dispose();}catch(Exception error){RecordCleanupFailure("token",stopping,error);}}

void RecordCleanupFailure(string phase,object resource,Exception error){lock(gate){cleanupFailures.Add(new(phase,resource.GetType().FullName??resource.GetType().Name,error));failedResources.Add(resource);}}

facts.to: 删除记录在Dispose之前完成；首个异常中断剩余裁剪
facts.behavior: RemoveNode在root.gate内先删除effectiveParameters键，再从states.Remove取出value；离锁后仅当value实现IDisposable才Dispose，没有catch和RecordCleanupFailure。Dispose抛错时该node状态及参数已从这些字典移除，调用直接失败；重复RemoveNode找不到state就return，不自动重试旧对象。RetainProcedureNodes先批量删除不在keep中的全部参数键，再快照待移state键并foreach RemoveNode；其中一项抛错将中断剩余foreach，后续state仍可留在states，而其参数键可能已在第一阶段删除。
facts.representation: 节点状态字典移除、参数字典移除、对象Dispose完成分别发生，不能用一个成功/失败标记代替。
facts.cache: 没有被循环走到的state仍由root.states持有，可在之后的裁剪或root关闭进入其它清理；已移除但Dispose失败对象不由本分支自动放入failedResources。若它另被owned服务/外部持有，则还需单独判断。
facts.release: 单节点Remove/批量Retain与root Release有不同异常屏障；root Release的逐项继续保证不能外推到这两个入口。

refs.excerpt: public void RemoveNode(string module,string node){var root=Root;object? value;lock(root.gate){root.effectiveParameters.Remove((ProcedureId,module,node));if(!root.states.Remove((ProcedureId,module,node),out value))return;}if(value is IDisposable disposable)disposable.Dispose();}

void RetainProcedureNodes(IEnumerable<(string Procedure,string Module,string Node)> current,string? only){var root=Root;var keep=current.ToHashSet();lock(root.gate){foreach(var key in root.effectiveParameters.Keys.Where(k=>(only is null||k.Procedure==only)&&!keep.Contains(k)).ToArray())root.effectiveParameters.Remove(key);}(string Procedure,string Module,string Node)[] removed;lock(root.gate)removed=root.states.Keys.Where(k=>(only is null||k.Procedure==only)&&!keep.Contains(k)).ToArray();foreach(var key in removed){if(key.Procedure.Length==0)root.RemoveNode(key.Module,key.Node);else root.ForProcedure(key.Procedure).RemoveNode(key.Module,key.Node);}}

void RetainExecutionNodes(){var nodes=doc.Document.Procedures.SelectMany(p=>p.Nodes.Select(n=>(p.Id,n.ModuleId,n.Id))).ToHashSet();executionScope.RetainProcedureNodes(nodes);foreach(var key in pointAliasPresentation.Keys.Where(k=>!nodes.Contains(k)).ToArray())pointAliasPresentation.Remove(key);}

facts.from: root closing置位与API准入 / 租约
facts.to: 立即拒新状态与租约，不等于所有查询/删除都禁用
facts.behavior: root Dispose在gate下先设置closing=true再调用stopping.Cancel；State<T>、RegisterService、Enter与参数Parameters入口均以closing抛ObjectDisposedException。与之不同，Service<T>只锁gate查询，无closing检查：若活跃租约阻止Release清字典，它仍可在closing期间返回旧服务；Release清空后则返回null。ForProcedure只验证procedure字符串，可以继续生成borrowed view；RequestRun/RequestRefresh在closing直接返回。RemoveNode与RetainProcedureNodes没有closing或leases门，故root完整Release等待租约不能被概括成任何节点移除/替换都受同一租约保护。
facts.representation: closing是操作级准入状态；cancellationComplete与leases控制root Release时机。借用view的存在本身不证明其API可继续使用。
facts.cache: 在Release前states/services可能仍保留；State即使只是想取已有值也先拒绝，Service查询则未使用同样策略。
facts.release: Enter取得的Lease仅参与root TryRelease；Lease自身Interlocked.Exchange确保一次Exit。它不替代调用者在RemoveNode等入口的并发协调。

public void RegisterService<T>(T service,bool owned=true)where T:class{if(owner is not null){owner.RegisterService(service,owned);return;}ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(service);lock(gate){ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(closing,this);if(services.TryGetValue(typeof(T),out var previous)&&!ReferenceEquals(previous,service)&&ownedServices.Remove(previous)&&previous is IDisposable disposable)disposable.Dispose();services[typeof(T)]=service;if(owned)ownedServices.Add(service);}}
 public T? Service<T>()where T:class{if(owner is not null)return owner.Service<T>();lock(gate)return services.TryGetValue(typeof(T),out var value)?(T)value:null;}
public ModuleExecutionScope ForProcedure(string procedure){ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(procedure);return ProcedureId==procedure?this:new(Root,procedure);}

public void RequestRun(string node){var root=Root;if(root.closing)return;root.ProcedureRunRequested?.Invoke(new(root.Id,ProcedureId,node));if(ProcedureId.Length==0)root.RunRequested?.Invoke(node);}
 public void RequestRefresh(string node){var root=Root;if(root.closing)return;root.ProcedureRefreshRequested?.Invoke(new(root.Id,ProcedureId,node));if(ProcedureId.Length==0)root.RefreshRequested?.Invoke(node);}

public IDisposable Enter(){if(owner is not null)return owner.Enter();lock(gate){ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(closing,this);leases++;return new Lease(this);}}
 public void RemoveNode(string module,string node){var root=Root;object? value;lock(root.gate){root.effectiveParameters.Remove((ProcedureId,module,node));if(!root.states.Remove((ProcedureId,module,node),out value))return;}if(value is IDisposable disposable)disposable.Dispose();}

EffectiveParameters Parameters(string module,string node){var root=Root;lock(root.gate){ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(root.closing,this);var key=(ProcedureId,module,node);if(!root.effectiveParameters.TryGetValue(key,out var value))root.effectiveParameters[key]=value=new();return value;}}

facts.from: 取消或资源Dispose异常后的root Dispose / Lease.Exit
facts.to: root清理是一次性尝试；failedResources保留不等于排队重试
facts.behavior: Dispose设置closing后，stopping.Cancel抛Exception会RecordCleanupFailure(cancel,stopping,error)，finally仍设置cancellationComplete并TryRelease；不是因取消回调异常就跳过该finally。TryRelease要求closing、cancellationComplete、leases==0且!releaseStarted，在真正Release前置releaseStarted=true。Release对各IDisposable的Exception分别记录后继续下一资源，并单独尝试stopping.Dispose；这点现有CR06已有，本事实新增明确重试边界：root重复Dispose因closing立即return，后续Exit也因releaseStarted不再启动第二遍，failedResources只保留对象，所选类没有重试/清空该表的方法。
facts.representation: CleanupFailures getter返回失败记录数组副本；内部failedResources保存真实资源引用。诊断快照与资源持有是两层。
facts.cache: 失败对象及其Exception可继续使资源图可达；保留到root仍可达不等于资源已释放，也不等于有后台重试任务。
facts.release: Release前先清states/有效参数/services/ownedServices，失败不会把原索引恢复。普通单项Dispose抛Exception不会阻断后续项；但分配快照、RecordCleanupFailure自身异常或进程级故障等未被这一逐资源catch覆盖。

refs.excerpt: public void Dispose(){if(owner is not null)return;lock(gate){if(closing)return;closing=true;}try{stopping.Cancel();}catch(Exception error){RecordCleanupFailure("cancel",stopping,error);}finally{bool release;lock(gate){cancellationComplete=true;release=TryRelease();}if(release)Release();}}
bool TryRelease(){if(!closing||!cancellationComplete||leases!=0||releaseStarted)return false;releaseStarted=true;return true;}
void Exit(){bool release;lock(gate){leases--;release=TryRelease();}if(release)Release();}
